name: smwgraphics-terranigma-lhasa
title: Terranigma - Lhasa
description:
A mountain background seen in Lhasa, from Terranigma. Compared to the older version, this one uses a few more tiles, but has much more optimized map 16, better palette organization and it is extracted directly from an in-game tilemap. The background does not scroll, like in the original game. A good fit for mountain levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
